# ------------------------------------------------------------
# A management presentation built from the reports / statistics data.
#
#   * the DATA: contractors who entered in a chosen date range, split by project, by
#     information-security status (approved / approved by exception / not approved), by
#     expiry state, by inviter, with trend and busiest hours; plus any number of custom
#     slides (a status / project / inviter filter and a view);
#   * two ways to SHOW it: on screen as a flowing presentation (the page renders the
#     JSON below), or as a PowerPoint file written INTO YOUR OWN TEMPLATE: the
#     template's slide masters, layouts, theme colours, fonts, backgrounds and images are
#     kept as they are; the slides are new (title slide + content slides with native,
#     editable charts and tables).
#
#   GET    /reports/deck/options          slide catalogue, saved templates   (reports.view)
#   POST   /reports/deck/data             the deck as JSON (for the on-screen show) (reports.view)
#   POST   /reports/deck/export           the .pptx                          (reports.export)
#   GET    /reports/deck/templates        saved templates                    (reports.view)
#   POST   /reports/deck/templates?name=  save a template (raw .pptx body)   (reports.export)
#   DELETE /reports/deck/templates/{id}                                      (reports.export)
#
# The .pptx is written with the standard library (zipfile) plus openpyxl (already a dependency,
# used for the small Excel sheets embedded behind every chart so "Edit data" works in PowerPoint).
# Metric definitions: "contractors who entered" = distinct visitors with at least one entry in the
# period; the status / project / inviter are the visitor's CURRENT values.

# ====================================================================== the data
def dmy(d: date) -> str:
    return d.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")


def _iso(value: Optional[str], name: str) -> Optional[date]:
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="תאריך לא תקין ב'{}'".format(name))


def _bucket_plan(start: date, end: date):
    """(kind, labels, key function): daily up to 31 days, weekly up to ~6 months, else monthly."""
    days = (end - start).days + 1
    if days <= 31:
        keys = [start + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(days)]
        return "day", keys, lambda d: d, lambda k: k.strftime("%d.%m")
    if days <= 190:
        first = start - timedelta(days=start.weekday())
        keys, k = [], first
        while k <= end:
            keys.append(k)
            k += timedelta(days=7)
        return "week", keys, lambda d: d - timedelta(days=d.weekday()), lambda k: k.strftime("%d.%m")
    keys, k = [], date(start.year, start.month, 1)
    while k <= end:
        keys.append(k)
        k = date(k.year + (k.month // 12), k.month % 12 + 1, 1)
    return "month", keys, lambda d: date(d.year, d.month, 1), lambda k: k.strftime("%m.%Y")


def _load(db: Session, start: date, end: date, project: str, inviter: str):
    """Everything the slides need, in plain Python structures."""
    ctx = InviterContext(db)
    warn = get_int_setting(db, KEY_EXPIRY_DAYS, DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS)
    today = date.today()
    info: Dict[int, dict] = {}
    for v in db.query(models.Visitor).all():
        props = v.properties or {}
        p = get_project(props) or NO_PROJECT
        who = ctx.of(props)
        if project and p != project:
            continue
        if inviter and who.strip().lower() != inviter.strip().lower():
            continue
        ex = expiry_info(props, today, warn)
        info[v.dbid] = {
            "name": v.name,
            "vid": v.visitorid,
            "project": p,
            "status": _infosec_class(props),
            "expiry": ex["status"] if ex else "none",
            "inviter": who,
            "inside": bool(v.inside),
        }
    start_dt = datetime(start.year, start.month, start.day)
    end_dt = datetime(end.year, end.month, end.day) + timedelta(days=1)
    q = visible(
        db.query(models.VisitorLog.visitor_dbid, models.VisitorLog.action, models.VisitorLog.timestamp)
        .filter(models.VisitorLog.timestamp >= start_dt)
        .filter(models.VisitorLog.timestamp < end_dt)
    )
    entries: List[tuple] = []  # (dbid, datetime)
    exits = 0
    for dbid, action, ts in q.all():
        if dbid not in info or ts is None:
            continue
        a = (action or "").strip().lower()
        if a == ACTION_ENTRY:
            entries.append((dbid, ts))
        elif a == ACTION_EXIT:
            exits += 1
    return info, entries, exits


def _per_visitor(entries):
    cnt: Counter = Counter()
    last: Dict[int, datetime] = {}
    for dbid, ts in entries:
        cnt[dbid] += 1
        if dbid not in last or ts > last[dbid]:
            last[dbid] = ts
    return cnt, last


def _status_ok(cls: str, flt: str) -> bool:
    if not flt or flt == "all":
        return True
    if flt == "approved_any":
        return cls in ("approved", "exception")
    return cls == flt


def _chart(kind, cats, series):
    return {"type": kind, "categories": list(cats), "series": [{"name": n, "values": list(v)} for n, v in series]}


def _project_order(p: str):
    return (p == NO_PROJECT, p)


def _by_project(info, cnt, ids):
    """{project: [distinct contractors, entries]} for the given contractor ids."""
    out: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
    for d in ids:
        row = out.setdefault(info[d]["project"], [0, 0])
        row[0] += 1
        row[1] += cnt[d]
    return out


def _table_of_contractors(info, cnt, last, ids, show_names, limit=15):
    if show_names:
        ordered = sorted(ids, key=lambda d: (-cnt[d], info[d]["name"] or ""))[:limit]
        rows = [[info[d]["name"], info[d]["vid"], info[d]["project"], cnt[d], dmy(last[d].date())] for d in ordered]
        return {"columns": ["שם", "מספר זיהוי", "פרויקט", "כניסות", "כניסה אחרונה"], "rows": rows,
                "note": ("מוצגים {} הראשונים מתוך {}".format(len(rows), len(ids)) if len(ids) > limit else "")}
    bp = _by_project(info, cnt, ids)
    rows = [[p, bp[p][0], bp[p][1]] for p in sorted(bp, key=_project_order)]
    return {"columns": ["פרויקט", "קבלנים", "כניסות"], "rows": rows, "note": ""}


def build_deck(db: Session, params: DeckParams) -> dict:
    today = date.today()
    end = _iso(params.date_to, "עד תאריך") or today
    start = _iso(params.date_from, "מתאריך") or (end - timedelta(days=89))
    if start > end:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="'מתאריך' מאוחר מ'עד תאריך'")
    if (end - start).days > 800:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="אפשר לבחור עד כ-26 חודשים")
    project = (params.project or "").strip()
    inviter = (params.inviter or "").strip()
    info, entries, exits = _load(db, start, end, project, inviter)
    cnt, last = _per_visitor(entries)
    entered = list(cnt.keys())
    days = (end - start).days + 1
    kind, bkeys, bucket, blabel = _bucket_plan(start, end)
    period = "מ-{} עד {}".format(dmy(start), dmy(end))
    scope_txt = "  |  ".join(([("פרויקט: " + project)] if project else []) + ([("מזמין: " + inviter)] if inviter else []))
    names = bool(params.show_names)
    by_status: Dict[str, List[int]] = {k: [] for k in STATUS_NAMES}
    for d in entered:
        by_status[info[d]["status"]].append(d)
    deck = {
        "title": params.title.strip() or "סיכום פעילות קבלנים",
        "subtitle": period + (("  |  " + scope_txt) if scope_txt else ""),
        "period": {"from": start.isoformat(), "to": end.isoformat(), "days": days, "text": period},
        "generated": dmy(today),
        "slides": [],
    }

    def add(key, title, **kw):
        s = {"key": key, "title": title}
        s.update(kw)
        deck["slides"].append(s)

    want = [k for k in params.slides if k in {s[0] for s in SLIDES}]
    for key, _label, _d in SLIDES:
        if key not in want:
            continue
        if key == "kpis":
            avg = len(entries) / days
            add(key, "סיכום כללי", kind="kpis", kpis=[
                {"label": "קבלנים שנכנסו (שונים)", "value": len(entered)},
                {"label": "כניסות", "value": len(entries)},
                {"label": "יציאות", "value": exits},
                {"label": "ממוצע כניסות ליום", "value": round(avg, 1)},
                {"label": "בפנים כרגע", "value": sum(1 for d in info.values() if d["inside"])},
                {"label": "קבלנים רשומים", "value": len(info)},
            ], note="התקופה: " + period + ". קבלן שנכנס כמה פעמים נספר פעם אחת ב'קבלנים שנכנסו'.")
        elif key == "trend":
            en = Counter(bucket(ts.date()) for _d, ts in entries)
            add(key, "מגמת כניסות" + {"day": " לפי יום", "week": " לפי שבוע", "month": " לפי חודש"}[kind], kind="chart",
                chart=_chart("line" if kind != "month" else "bar", [blabel(k) for k in bkeys], [("כניסות", [en.get(k, 0) for k in bkeys])]))
        elif key == "by_project":
            bp = _by_project(info, cnt, entered)
            ps = sorted(bp, key=_project_order)
            add(key, "קבלנים לפי פרויקט", kind="chart", chart=_chart("bar", ps, [("קבלנים שונים", [bp[p][0] for p in ps]), ("כניסות", [bp[p][1] for p in ps])]),
                table={"columns": ["פרויקט", "קבלנים", "כניסות"], "rows": [[p, bp[p][0], bp[p][1]] for p in ps] + ([['סה"כ', len(entered), len(entries)]] if len(ps) > 1 else []), "note": ""})
        elif key == "infosec":
            ks = [k for k in STATUS_NAMES if by_status[k] or k in ("approved", "exception", "denied")]
            add(key, "קבלנים לפי אישור אבטחת מידע", kind="chart", chart=_chart("doughnut", [STATUS_NAMES[k] for k in ks], [("קבלנים", [len(by_status[k]) for k in ks])]),
                table={"columns": ["סטטוס", "קבלנים", "כניסות"], "rows": [[STATUS_NAMES[k], len(by_status[k]), sum(cnt[d] for d in by_status[k])] for k in ks], "note": "הסטטוס נכון להיום"})
        elif key == "infosec_by_project":
            ps = sorted({info[d]["project"] for d in entered}, key=_project_order)

        elif key == "inviters":

    # custom slides: a filter + a view
    for c in params.custom:
        flt = c.infosec if c.infosec in STATUS_FILTERS else "all"

               and (not c.inviter or info[d]["inviter"].strip().lower() == c.inviter.strip().lower())]
        bits = [STATUS_FILTERS[flt]] + ([c.project] if c.project else []) + ([c.inviter] if c.inviter else [])

        kp = [{"label": "קבלנים", "value": len(ids)}, {"label": "כניסות", "value": sum(cnt[d] for d in ids)}]
        view = c.view if c.view in CUSTOM_VIEWS else "by_project"
        if view == "by_project":
            bp = _by_project(info, cnt, ids)

            add("custom", title, kind="status", kpis=kp, chart=_chart("bar", ps, [("קבלנים", [bp[p][0] for p in ps])]) if ps else None,
                table={"columns": ["פרויקט", "קבלנים", "כניסות"], "rows": [[p, bp[p][0], bp[p][1]] for p in ps], "note": ""})
        elif view == "by_inviter":
            ic = Counter(info[d]["inviter"] for d in ids)

            add("custom", title, kind="status", kpis=kp, chart=_chart("bar", [w for w, _n in top], [("קבלנים", [n for _w, n in top])]) if top else None,
                table={"columns": ["מזמין", "קבלנים"], "rows": [[w, n] for w, n in top], "note": ""})
        elif view == "trend":
            idset = set(ids)
            en = Counter(bucket(ts.date()) for d, ts in entries if d in idset)
            add("custom", title, kind="status", kpis=kp, chart=_chart("line" if kind != "month" else "bar", [blabel(k) for k in bkeys], [("כניסות", [en.get(k, 0) for k in bkeys])]), table=None)
        else:
            add("custom", title, kind="status", kpis=kp, chart=None, table=_table_of_contractors(info, cnt, last, ids, names, limit=18))
    return deck

class _Rels:
    """Reads a .rels file; resolves targets to package paths."""

    @staticmethod
    def read(parts: Dict[str, bytes], rels_path: str):
        data = parts.get(rels_path)
        out = []
        if not data:
            return out
        text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        for m in re.finditer(r"<Relationship\b([^>]*)/?>", text):
            attrs = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)="([^"]*)"', m.group(1)))
            out.append(attrs)
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def source_of(rels_path: str) -> str:
        d, f = posixpath.split(rels_path)
        base = posixpath.dirname(d)
        return posixpath.join(base, f[: -len(".rels")]) if f.endswith(".rels") else rels_path

    @staticmethod
    def resolve(rels_path: str, target: str) -> str:
        src = _Rels.source_of(rels_path)
        if target.startswith("/"):
            return target.lstrip("/")
        return posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(src), target))


class Deck:
    def __init__(self, template: bytes, rtl: bool = True):
        try:
            z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(template))
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            raise TemplateError("הקובץ אינו קובץ PowerPoint תקין")
        self.parts: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
        for n in z.namelist():
            if n.endswith("/"):
                continue
            self.parts[n] = z.read(n)
        for need in ("[Content_Types].xml", "ppt/presentation.xml", "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"):
            if need not in self.parts:
                raise TemplateError("בתבנית חסר החלק " + need)
        self.rtl = rtl
        pres = self.parts["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
        m = re.search(r'<p:sldSz\b[^>]*cx="(\d+)"[^>]*cy="(\d+)"', pres) or re.search(r'<p:sldSz\b[^>]*cy="(\d+)"[^>]*cx="(\d+)"', pres)
        if not m:
            raise TemplateError("בתבנית חסר גודל שקף")
        a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        self.W, self.H = (a, b) if 'cx="%d"' % a in m.group(0) else (b, a)
        self._scan_layouts()
        self.slides: List[dict] = []  # {path, xml, rels:[(rid,type,target)]}
        self.charts: List[tuple] = []  # (path, xml, xlsx_bytes, n)
        self._sid = 0

    # ---- layouts
    def _ph_list(self, xml: str):
        out = []
        for m in re.finditer(r"<p:ph\b([^>]*?)/?>", xml):
            attrs = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)="([^"]*)"', m.group(1)))
            out.append(attrs)
        return out

    def _xfrm_of(self, xml: str, ph_type: str):
        """x, y, cx, cy of the first placeholder of the given type with an explicit position."""
        for sp in re.findall(r"<p:sp>.*?</p:sp>", xml, re.S):
            m = re.search(r"<p:ph\b([^>]*?)/?>", sp)
            if not m:
                continue
            t = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)="([^"]*)"', m.group(1))).get("type", "obj")
            if t == ph_type or (ph_type == "title" and t == "ctrTitle"):
                o = re.search(r'<a:off x="(-?\d+)" y="(-?\d+)"\s*/>\s*<a:ext cx="(\d+)" cy="(\d+)"', sp)
                if o:
                    return tuple(int(v) for v in o.groups())
        return None

    def _scan_layouts(self):
        pres_rels = _Rels.read(self.parts, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
        master_paths = [_Rels.resolve("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels", r["Target"]) for r in pres_rels if r.get("Type", "").endswith("/slideMaster")]
        layouts = []
        for mp in master_paths:
            mrels = _Rels.read(self.parts, posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(mp), "_rels", posixpath.basename(mp) + ".rels"))
            for r in mrels:
                if r.get("Type", "").endswith("/slideLayout"):
                    lp = _Rels.resolve(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(mp), "_rels", posixpath.basename(mp) + ".rels"), r["Target"])
                    if lp in self.parts:
                        layouts.append((lp, mp))
        if not layouts:
            raise TemplateError("בתבנית אין פריסות (layouts)")
        info = []
        for lp, mp in layouts:
            xml = self.parts[lp].decode("utf-8", "replace")
            phs = self._ph_list(xml)
            types = [p.get("type", "obj") for p in phs]
            name = (re.search(r'<p:cSld\b[^>]*name="([^"]*)"', xml) or [None, ""])[1]
            attr_type = (re.search(r"<p:sldLayout\b[^>]*\btype=\"(\w+)\"", xml) or [None, ""])[1]
            info.append({"path": lp, "master": mp, "xml": xml, "phs": phs, "types": types, "name": name, "attr": attr_type,
                         "has_title": any(t in ("title", "ctrTitle") for t in types),
                         "has_body": any(t in ("body", "subTitle", "obj") for t in types)})
        titled = [i for i in info if i["has_title"]]
        if not titled:
            raise TemplateError("בפריסות של התבנית אין מקום לכותרת")
        title_l = next((i for i in titled if i["attr"] == "title" or "ctrTitle" in i["types"]), None) \
            or next((i for i in titled if re.search(r"title|כותרת", i["name"], re.I) and not re.search(r"only|content|תוכן", i["name"], re.I) and i["has_body"]), None) \
            or next((i for i in titled if i["has_body"]), titled[0])
        rest = [i for i in titled if i is not title_l]
        content_l = next((i for i in rest if i["attr"] == "titleOnly"), None) \
            or next((i for i in rest if not i["has_body"]), None) \
            or next((i for i in rest if i["attr"] == "obj"), None) \
            or (rest[0] if rest else title_l)
        self.title_layout, self.content_layout = title_l, content_l
        # where the content goes: below the title placeholder, aligned with it
        mxml = self.parts[content_l["master"]].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        t = self._xfrm_of(content_l["xml"], "title") or self._xfrm_of(mxml, "title")
        if t:
            x, y, cx, cy = t
            self.region = (max(x, int(0.04 * self.W)), min(y + cy + int(0.02 * self.H), int(0.35 * self.H)), min(cx, int(0.92 * self.W)))
        else:
            self.region = (int(0.06 * self.W), int(0.22 * self.H), int(0.88 * self.W))

    # ---- shapes
    def _id(self) -> int:
        self._sid += 1
        return self._sid + 1

    def _run(self, text, sz, bold=False, color="tx1", font="+mn-lt"):
        return ('<a:r><a:rPr lang="he-IL" sz="%d"%s dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill>'
                '<a:latin typeface="%s"/><a:cs typeface="%s"/></a:rPr><a:t>%s</a:t></a:r>') % (
            sz * 100, ' b="1"' if bold else "", color, font, font.replace("lt", "cs"), _x(text))

    def _para(self, runs, algn=None):
        algn = algn or ("r" if self.rtl else "l")
        return '<a:p><a:pPr algn="%s"%s/>%s</a:p>' % (algn, ' rtl="1"' if self.rtl else "", runs)

    def _placeholder(self, ph: dict, text: str):
        attrs = "".join(' %s="%s"' % (k, v) for k, v in ph.items() if k in ("type", "idx", "sz", "orient"))
        return ('<p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="%d" name="%s"/><p:cNvSpPr><a:spLocks noGrp="1"/></p:cNvSpPr><p:nvPr><p:ph%s/></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr/>'
                '<p:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/><a:p>%s<a:r><a:rPr lang="he-IL" dirty="0"/><a:t>%s</a:t></a:r></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp>') % (
            self._id(), "Placeholder", attrs, '<a:pPr rtl="1"/>' if self.rtl else "", _x(text))

    def _textbox(self, x, y, w, h, paras, name="Text", fill=None, line=None, anchor="t", geom="rect"):
        sp = '<a:xfrm><a:off x="%d" y="%d"/><a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="%s"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>' % (x, y, w, h, geom)
        sp += ('<a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill>' % fill) if fill else "<a:noFill/>"
        sp += ('<a:ln w="9525"><a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill></a:ln>' % line) if line else "<a:ln><a:noFill/></a:ln>"
        return ('<p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="%d" name="%s"/><p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr>%s</p:spPr>'
                '<p:txBody><a:bodyPr wrap="square" lIns="91440" tIns="45720" rIns="91440" bIns="45720" anchor="%s"%s><a:normAutofit/></a:bodyPr><a:lstStyle/>%s</p:txBody></p:sp>') % (
            self._id(), _x(name), sp, anchor, ' rtlCol="1"' if self.rtl else "", "".join(paras))

    def _table(self, x, y, w, columns, rows, row_h=None, sz=12):
        cols = list(columns)
        data = [list(r) for r in rows]
        if self.rtl:  # tables run left to right: put the first column on the right
            cols.reverse()
            data = [r[::-1] for r in data]
        n = len(cols)
        lens = [max([len(str(cols[i]))] + [len(str(r[i])) for r in data[:40]]) + 3 for i in range(n)]
        tot = float(sum(lens))
        widths = [int(w * l / tot) for l in lens]
        widths[-1] += w - sum(widths)
        rh = row_h or int(0.36 * EMU)
        grid = "".join('<a:gridCol w="%d"/>' % cw for cw in widths)
        border = '<a:{0} w="6350"><a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="tx1"><a:alpha val="25000"/></a:schemeClr></a:solidFill></a:{0}>'

        def cell(text, head, band):
            fill = '<a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="accent1"/></a:solidFill>' if head else (
                '<a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="bg2"/></a:solidFill>' if band else '<a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="bg1"/></a:solidFill>')
            runs = self._run(text, sz, bold=head, color="bg1" if head else "tx1")
            return ('<a:tc><a:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/>%s</a:txBody><a:tcPr marL="72000" marR="72000" marT="36000" marB="36000" anchor="ctr">%s%s%s%s%s</a:tcPr></a:tc>') % (
                self._para(runs), border.format("lnL"), border.format("lnR"), border.format("lnT"), border.format("lnB"), fill)

        trs = '<a:tr h="%d">%s</a:tr>' % (rh, "".join(cell(c, True, False) for c in cols))
        for i, r in enumerate(data):
            trs += '<a:tr h="%d">%s</a:tr>' % (rh, "".join(cell(c, False, i % 2 == 1) for c in r))
        h = rh * (len(data) + 1)
        return ('<p:graphicFrame><p:nvGraphicFramePr><p:cNvPr id="%d" name="Table"/><p:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noGrp="1"/></p:cNvGraphicFramePr><p:nvPr/></p:nvGraphicFramePr>'
                '<p:xfrm><a:off x="%d" y="%d"/><a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/></p:xfrm><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/table">'
                '<a:tbl><a:tblPr firstRow="1" bandRow="1"/><a:tblGrid>%s</a:tblGrid>%s</a:tbl></a:graphicData></a:graphic></p:graphicFrame>') % (
            self._id(), x, y, w, h, grid, trs), h

    def _chart_frame(self, x, y, w, h, rid):
        return ('<p:graphicFrame><p:nvGraphicFramePr><p:cNvPr id="%d" name="Chart"/><p:cNvGraphicFramePr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGraphicFramePr>'
                '<p:xfrm><a:off x="%d" y="%d"/><a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/></p:xfrm><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart">'
                '<c:chart xmlns:c="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart" r:id="%s"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></p:graphicFrame>') % (self._id(), x, y, w, h, rid)

    # ---- charts

            cat = '<c:cat><c:strRef><c:f>Sheet1!$A$2:$A$%d</c:f><c:strCache>%s</c:strCache></c:strRef></c:cat>' % (nC + 1, strcache(cats))

                    i, i, tx, acc, dl if kind == "bar" else "", cat, val)

                         '<c:marker><c:symbol val="circle"/><c:size val="6"/><c:spPr><a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill></c:spPr></c:marker>%s%s%s<c:smooth val="0"/></c:ser>') % (i, i, tx, acc, acc, dl, cat, val)
            else:  # pie / doughnut: one colour per slice

                sers += '<c:ser><c:idx val="%d"/><c:order val="%d"/>%s%s%s%s%s</c:ser>' % (i, i, tx, dpts, dl, cat, val)
        axes = ""
        if kind in ("bar", "stackedbar", "line"):
            axes = ('<c:catAx><c:axId val="111"/><c:scaling><c:orientation val="minMax"/></c:scaling><c:delete val="0"/><c:axPos val="b"/><c:numFmt formatCode="General" sourceLinked="0"/>'
                    '<c:majorTickMark val="none"/><c:minorTickMark val="none"/><c:tickLblPos val="nextTo"/><c:spPr><a:ln w="9525"><a:solidFill><a:schemeClr val="tx1"><a:alpha val="35000"/></a:schemeClr></a:solidFill></a:ln></c:spPr>'
                    + txpr % 1100 + '<c:crossAx val="222"/><c:crosses val="autoZero"/><c:auto val="1"/><c:lblAlgn val="ctr"/><c:lblOffset val="100"/><c:noMultiLvlLbl val="0"/></c:catAx>'

    def _chart_xlsx(self, ch: dict) -> bytes:
        from openpyxl import Workbook

        wb = Workbook()
        ws = wb.active
        ws.title = "Sheet1"
        ws.append([""] + [s["name"] for s in ch["series"]])
        for i, c in enumerate(ch["categories"]):
            ws.append([c] + [s["values"][i] for s in ch["series"]])
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        wb.save(buf)
        return buf.getvalue()

    # ---- slides
    def _new_slide(self, layout: dict, shapes: List[str], charts: List[tuple]):
        n = len(self.slides) + 1
        path = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % n
        xml = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<p:sld %s><p:cSld><p:spTree><p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>'
               '<p:grpSpPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/><a:chOff x="0" y="0"/><a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/></a:xfrm></p:grpSpPr>%s</p:spTree></p:cSld>'
               '<p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>') % (NS, "".join(shapes))
        rels = [("rId1", REL + "/slideLayout", "../slideLayouts/" + posixpath.basename(layout["path"]))]
        for i, (cpath, _x_) in enumerate(charts):
            rels.append(("rId%d" % (i + 2), REL + "/chart", "../charts/" + posixpath.basename(cpath)))
        self.slides.append({"path": path, "xml": xml, "rels": rels})

    def _add_chart(self, ch: dict):
        n = len(self.charts) + 1
        cpath = "ppt/charts/chart%d.xml" % n
        self.charts.append((cpath, self._chart_xml(ch), self._chart_xlsx(ch), n))
        return cpath

    def title_slide(self, title: str, subtitle: str, footer: str = ""):
        L = self.title_layout
        shapes = []
        sub_done = False
        for ph in L["phs"]:
            t = ph.get("type", "obj")
            if t in ("title", "ctrTitle"):
                shapes.append(self._placeholder(ph, title))
            elif t in ("subTitle", "body", "obj") and not sub_done:
                shapes.append(self._placeholder(ph, subtitle))
                sub_done = True
        if footer:
            shapes.append(self._textbox(int(0.06 * self.W), int(0.9 * self.H), int(0.88 * self.W), int(0.06 * self.H), [self._para(self._run(footer, 12, color="tx1"))], "Footer"))
        self._new_slide(L, shapes, [])

    def content_slide(self, spec: dict):
        L = self.content_layout
        shapes, charts = [], []
        for ph in L["phs"]:
            if ph.get("type") in ("title", "ctrTitle"):
                shapes.append(self._placeholder(ph, spec["title"]))
                break
        x0, y0, cw = self.region
        bottom = int(0.93 * self.H)
        if "kpis" in spec:
            n = len(spec["kpis"])
            big = spec.get("kind") == "kpis"
            gap = int(0.02 * self.W)
            if big:
                per_row = 3
                cwid = (cw - gap * (per_row - 1)) // per_row
                chei = int(1.55 * EMU) if (bottom - y0) > 3.4 * EMU else int(1.25 * EMU)
                for i, k in enumerate(spec["kpis"]):
                    r, c = divmod(i, per_row)
                    cx = x0 + cw - (c + 1) * cwid - c * gap if self.rtl else x0 + c * (cwid + gap)
                    cy = y0 + r * (chei + gap)
                    shapes.append(self._textbox(cx, cy, cwid, chei, [self._para(self._run(k["value"], 36, True, "accent1", "+mj-lt"), "ctr"), self._para(self._run(k["label"], 14), "ctr")],
                                                "KPI", fill="bg1", line="accent1", anchor="ctr", geom="roundRect"))
                y_next = y0 + ((n + per_row - 1) // per_row) * (chei + gap)
                if spec.get("note"):
                    shapes.append(self._textbox(x0, min(y_next, bottom - int(0.5 * EMU)), cw, int(0.5 * EMU), [self._para(self._run(spec["note"], 13))], "Note"))
            else:
                cwid, chei = int(1.9 * EMU), int(1.0 * EMU)
                for i, k in enumerate(spec["kpis"]):
                    cx = x0 + cw - (i + 1) * cwid - i * gap if self.rtl else x0 + i * (cwid + gap)
                    shapes.append(self._textbox(cx, y0, cwid, chei, [self._para(self._run(k["value"], 28, True, "accent1", "+mj-lt"), "ctr"), self._para(self._run(k["label"], 12), "ctr")],
                                                "KPI", fill="bg1", line="accent1", anchor="ctr", geom="roundRect"))
                y0 += chei + gap
        ch, tb = spec.get("chart"), spec.get("table")
        avail = bottom - y0
        if ch and tb and tb["rows"]:
            cwid = int(cw * 0.56)
            twid = cw - cwid - int(0.02 * self.W)
            chart_x = x0 if self.rtl else x0 + twid + int(0.02 * self.W)
            tab_x = x0 + cwid + int(0.02 * self.W) if self.rtl else x0
            charts.append((self._add_chart(ch), None))
            shapes.append(self._chart_frame(chart_x, y0, cwid, avail, "rId2"))
            rows = tb["rows"][:16]
            fs = 12 if len(rows) <= 9 else 11
            frame, h = self._table(tab_x, y0, twid, tb["columns"], rows, row_h=int(min(0.38 * EMU, avail / (len(rows) + 1))), sz=fs)
            shapes.append(frame)
            if tb.get("note"):
                shapes.append(self._textbox(tab_x, min(y0 + h + int(0.05 * EMU), bottom - int(0.4 * EMU)), twid, int(0.4 * EMU), [self._para(self._run(tb["note"], 11))], "Note"))
        elif ch:
            charts.append((self._add_chart(ch), None))
            shapes.append(self._chart_frame(x0, y0, cw, avail, "rId2"))
        elif tb:
            rows = tb["rows"][:18]
            frame, h = self._table(x0, y0, cw, tb["columns"], rows, row_h=int(min(0.4 * EMU, avail / (len(rows) + 1))), sz=13 if len(rows) <= 12 else 11)
            shapes.append(frame)
            if tb.get("note"):
                shapes.append(self._textbox(x0, min(y0 + h + int(0.05 * EMU), bottom - int(0.4 * EMU)), cw, int(0.4 * EMU), [self._para(self._run(tb["note"], 11))], "Note"))
        self._new_slide(L, shapes, charts)

    # ---- assemble
    def finish(self) -> bytes:
        parts = {k: v for k, v in self.parts.items() if not (k.startswith("ppt/slides/") or k.startswith("ppt/notesSlides/") or k.startswith("ppt/charts/") or k.startswith("ppt/embeddings/"))}
        ct = parts["[Content_Types].xml"].decode("utf-8")
        ct = re.sub(r'<Override\b[^>]*PartName="/ppt/(slides|notesSlides|charts)/[^>]*/>', "", ct)
        add_ct = ""
        if not re.search(r'<Default\b[^>]*Extension="xlsx"', ct):
            add_ct += '<Default Extension="xlsx" ContentType="%s"/>' % CT_XLSX
        rel_xml = parts["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode("utf-8")
        rel_xml = re.sub(r'<Relationship\b[^>]*Type="[^"]*/slide"[^>]*/>', "", rel_xml)
        ids = [int(i) for i in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rel_xml)] or [0]
        nxt = max(ids) + 1
        sld_ids = ""
        new_rels = ""
        for i, s in enumerate(self.slides):
            rid = "rId%d" % (nxt + i)
            new_rels += '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s/slide" Target="slides/slide%d.xml"/>' % (rid, REL, i + 1)
            sld_ids += '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="%s"/>' % (256 + i, rid)
            add_ct += '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>' % (s["path"], CT_SLIDE)
            parts[s["path"]] = s["xml"].encode("utf-8")
            body = "".join('<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>' % r for r in s["rels"])
            parts["ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % (i + 1)] = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">%s</Relationships>' % body).encode("utf-8")
        for cpath, cxml, xlsx, n in self.charts:
            parts[cpath] = cxml.encode("utf-8")
            parts["ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Sheet%d.xlsx" % n] = xlsx
            parts["ppt/charts/_rels/chart%d.xml.rels" % n] = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'
                                                              '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s/package" Target="../embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Sheet%d.xlsx"/></Relationships>' % (REL, n)).encode("utf-8")
            add_ct += '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>' % (cpath, CT_CHART)
        parts["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = rel_xml.replace("</Relationships>", new_rels + "</Relationships>").encode("utf-8")
        parts["[Content_Types].xml"] = ct.replace("</Types>", add_ct + "</Types>").encode("utf-8")
        pres = parts["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
        lst = "<p:sldIdLst>%s</p:sldIdLst>" % sld_ids
        if re.search(r"<p:sldIdLst\b", pres):
            pres = re.sub(r"<p:sldIdLst\b[^>]*?(/>|>.*?</p:sldIdLst>)", lst, pres, count=1, flags=re.S)
        else:
            m = re.search(r"</p:(handoutMasterIdLst|notesMasterIdLst|sldMasterIdLst)>", pres)
            if not m:
                raise TemplateError("מבנה התבנית לא תקין (presentation.xml)")
            pres = pres[: m.end()] + lst + pres[m.end():]
        parts["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres.encode("utf-8")
        # keep only what is reachable from the package root (drops media / notes of the removed slides)
        keep = set(["[Content_Types].xml"])
        queue = ["_rels/.rels"]
        seen = set()
        while queue:
            rp = queue.pop()
            if rp in seen or rp not in parts:
                continue
            seen.add(rp)
            keep.add(rp)
            for r in _Rels.read(parts, rp):
                if r.get("TargetMode") == "External":
                    continue
                t = _Rels.resolve(rp, r["Target"]) if rp != "_rels/.rels" else r["Target"].lstrip("/")
                if t in parts and t not in keep:
                    keep.add(t)
                    d, f = posixpath.split(t)
                    queue.append(posixpath.join(d, "_rels", f + ".rels"))
        ct = parts["[Content_Types].xml"].decode("utf-8")
        ct = re.sub(r'<Override\b[^>]*PartName="/([^"]+)"[^>]*/>', lambda m: m.group(0) if m.group(1) in keep else "", ct)
        parts["[Content_Types].xml"] = ct.encode("utf-8")
        out = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            z.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", parts["[Content_Types].xml"])
            for n in sorted(keep):
                if n != "[Content_Types].xml":
                    z.writestr(n, parts[n])
        return out.getvalue()


def write_pptx(deck: dict, template: Optional[bytes] = None, rtl: bool = True) -> bytes:
    d = Deck(template or default_template(), rtl=rtl)
    d.title_slide(deck["title"], deck["subtitle"], "הופק: " + deck["generated"])
    for spec in deck["slides"]:
        d.content_slide(spec)
    return d.finish()

@router.post("/templates")
async def upload_template(
    request: Request,
    name: str = Query("", max_length=120),
    user: models.User = Depends(require_permission("reports.export")),
    db: Session = Depends(database.get_db),
):
    data = await request.body()
    if not data:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="לא נשלח קובץ")
    if len(data) > MAX_TEMPLATE_BYTES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="הקובץ גדול מ-30MB")
    try:
        Deck(data)  # validates: a real pptx with masters and layouts that have a title
    except TemplateError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    row = ReportTemplate(name=(name.strip() or "תבנית"), data=data, size=len(data))
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    from . import settings_store

    settings_store.audit(db, user, "deck.template.add", row.name)
    return {"id": row.id, "name": row.name, "size": row.size}

@router.post("/export", dependencies=[Depends(require_permission("reports.export"))])
def deck_export(params: DeckParams, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db)):
    deck = build_deck(db, params)
    row = _template_row(db, params.template_id)
    try:
        content = write_pptx(deck, row.data if row else None)
    except TemplateError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    filename = "kav1_management_deck_{}.pptx".format(datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M"))
    return StreamingResponse(
        iter([content]),
        media_type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
        headers=_attachment(filename),
    )
